proposals.title: Implement branded numeric types and rounding-mode division helper in @ciclo/core
proposals.why_now: ADR-003 types (Money, Quantity, Price, Rate as bigint brands; Tick as safe-integer number brand) and ADR-004 (divide with explicit RoundingMode, residue return) are prerequisites for every economic computation in domain and world. Nothing in those packages can be written in a spec-compliant, type-safe way without them. ADR-004's technical enforcement mechanism is a DEFINIR item that requires an ADR before implementation. These types are independent of the CanonicalEncoder and can begin immediately; they must exist before the ledger, price generator, or tick loop can be assembled. FASE-1 scope cannot close without them.

proposals.title: Write hash function ADR and implement positional RNG in @ciclo/core
proposals.why_now: ADR-002 requires the hash function to be specified bit-by-bit in an ADR before implementation (DEFINIR). Without this ADR, no conforming rand() implementation can be reviewed against the spec. rand(masterSeed, namespace, ...coordinates) is the foundation of all world determinism — price octaves, macro events, bot policy, NPC tips. The 11 namespaces in the ADR-002 table are all currently unsampled. This work is fully independent of the CanonicalEncoder and of the numeric types; it can proceed in parallel. INV-02 (direct vs sequential price query equivalence) and INV-12 (no external entropy) cannot be tested without it.

proposals.title: Add minimal Electron app with INV-29 security config and CI installer
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 acceptance requires a minimal installer for Windows and Linux produced by CI, even if the application shows only the §20 mandatory disclaimer. §14.6 explicitly warns that deferring packaging exposes native module ABI, electron-builder path, and rebuild problems in the final phase when there is no time to fix architecture. Currently no Electron dependency exists anywhere in the monorepo. This work is completely independent of core logic; it does not need the encoder, numeric types, or RNG. Discovering electron-builder configuration and platform-specific issues now — not in FASE-7 — is the point of the FASE-1 requirement. INV-29 (contextIsolation, nodeIntegration false, sandbox true) must also be enforced by an automated verification step.

proposals.title: Implement double-entry ledger foundation in @ciclo/domain
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 requires a multi-commodity double-entry ledger (§6) and spot market orders with buy and sell (§15). The ledger is the economic backbone of every tick: every order execution, fee, and rounding residue flows through it. INV-04 (per-commodity transaction balance), INV-05 (BRL sum zero), INV-06 (asset quantity sum zero), and INV-07 (rounding residue accounts) cannot be verified without it. The implementation is dependency-ready once nominal types from IDEA-001 exist and is entirely within @ciclo/domain — it does not require world, narrative, RNG, or the encoder.

proposals.title: Implement two-layer price generator for two assets in @ciclo/world
proposals.why_now: FASE-1 requires a price generator with two noise layers and two assets (§15, §5.1). This is the earliest deliverable in @ciclo/world and a prerequisite for the canonical tick loop (§7), INV-02 (direct query equals sequential advance), and INV-03 (player actions do not alter world price). The formula in §5.1 uses trendLayer and idiosyncraticNoise (the two octave-based layers), which are purely positional and depend only on the RNG. Octave count, periods, and amplitudes are DEFINIR items that require an ADR and a versioned config file before implementation. Two assets (e.g. ORB and NEXA from the §4 table) with their archetype parameters are enough to satisfy the FASE-1 minimum.

warnings: TASK-0007 is the fourth attempt at the CanonicalEncoder (TASK-0004, TASK-0005, TASK-0006 all failed review). Its first implementation attempt is pending review with no review file yet committed. If rejected, six encoder implementations across 80 cycles with zero committed code represents a systemic process failure. The supervisor should consider whether the root cause is implementation quality, review-criterion precision, or a commit-gate issue outside implementation control — and address the root cause before commissioning a seventh attempt.

Even if TASK-0007 is accepted immediately, FASE-1 requires at minimum eight more deliverables beyond the encoder: nominal types, positional RNG, price generator, ledger, market orders, canonical tick loop, save format + replay CLI, installer, and minimal UI. All are at 0% completion. The remaining scope is large relative to the rate of committed progress.

Three DEFINIR items must be resolved via ADR before their dependent implementations can pass review: (1) the hash function for ADR-002 positional RNG (recommended: SplitMix64 over FNV-1a); (2) the technical enforcement mechanism for ADR-004 rounding-mode-at-call-site (compile error vs blocking lint); (3) octave count, periods, and amplitudes for the price generator in a versioned config file. Implementing any of these three features without the corresponding ADR first repeats the same pre-condition failure that blocked prior tasks.
